ConnectionStrings.//: Same shop database the .NET Framework host and Candela desktop use. Encrypt=False + TrustServerCertificate=True because Microsoft.Data.SqlClient encrypts by default and the LAN server has no matching certificate — without them the connection is refused.
ConnectionStrings.CON_STR: Password=lumensoft2003;Persist Security Info=True;User ID=sa;Initial Catalog=candela;Data Source=ho;Pooling=true;Max Pool Size=20;Encrypt=False;TrustServerCertificate=True

Jwt.//: Must be the SAME secret as the .NET Framework host for as long as both serve traffic, otherwise a token minted by one is rejected by the other.

Legacy.//: The .NET Framework host, reachable on loopback only. It is the sole route into the Candela DAL.
Legacy.//SharedSecret: MUST match Legacy:SharedSecret in the legacy host Web.config.

Cors.//: One origin per entry (scheme://host:port, no path, no trailing slash) — a comma-separated string also works. Normally empty in dev: the fallback list already covers the tablet's and Candela_WebInterface's local Vite ports.

Security.//: See AuthRules: false lets a group with no shop rights configured through, logging a warning.
